label: r00-original
what: Blitz3D 1.118, the original compiler and runtime (the baseline). Runs under Wine and llvmpipe here, which is only there to have a number next to the others

label: r01-pre84
what: BlitzLLVM before any performance change: one draw call per entity, no culling, no GPU thread, the first optimization level

label: r02-pr84-batching
what: Per-draw data in a storage buffer, equal draws merged into one instanced call, solid draws grouped by state, meshes outside the view skipped

label: r03-pr82-section-gc
what: Section garbage collection at link time, so programs drop unused code

label: r04-pr86-o3
what: `-O3 -funroll-loops` by default and safe fast-math flags on Float operations

label: r05-pr87-gpu-thread
what: Submit, fence wait and present on a thread of their own, so `Flip` returns early

label: r06-pr94-inline-checks
what: Index, division and object checks emitted inline with a cold branch; `Sqr`, `Floor`, `Sin` and others as LLVM intrinsics

label: r07-pr98-collision-tree
what: A bounding box tree per `Collisions` rule, so a mover tests only entities near its path

label: r08-pr85-sprite-cull
what: Sprites outside each camera's view are not sent to the GPU

label: r09-pr104-inline-runtime
what: `Peek`/`Poke` and `Rnd`/`Rand` emitted in the program; hot runtime sources built together with the program

label: r10-pr138-see-through-groups
what: See-through draws of equal state grouped in distance bands; input polled at most once per millisecond, no `getenv` per poll

label: r11-pr142-entity-creation
what: A `children` count and a `first_free` slot hint, so entity creation and `CopyEntity` stop scanning all entities

label: r12-pr125-ffmpeg-movies
what: Movies play with FFmpeg as shared libraries (new feature, larger package)

label: r13-pr131-profile-timers
what: Profiling timers only run in programs built with `--profile`

label: r14-pr150-vma
what: All GPU memory through VulkanMemoryAllocator

label: r15-pr158-prefetch
what: Prefetch the entities that the mesh scan and the draw loop read a few steps ahead

label: r16-pr162-ffmpeg-small
what: FFmpeg built with `--enable-small` and without code that only encoders and bitstream filters use

label: r17-pr156-kind-table
what: A byte table of entity kinds, so the scans for lights, cameras and mirrors do not read every entity

label: r18-pr169-no-swresample
what: libswresample dropped; movie sound goes through `SDL_AudioStream`

label: r19-pr175-opus-movies
what: Opus movie sound decoded with libopus, which is already linked

label: r20-pr151-gpu-timers
what: GPU thread time and per-pass GPU time in `BLITZ_FPS` (measurement only)

label: r21-pr167-two-frames
what: Two frames in flight: the CPU records frame N+1 while the GPU renders frame N

label: r22-pr173-mesh-spheres
what: A sphere around every mesh is remembered and tested before the entity is read

label: r23-pr190-sprite-spheres
what: A sphere around sprites too

label: r24-pr160-shared-codecs
what: Image codecs (AVIF, JPEG XL, WebP) as shared libraries

label: r25-pr205-transparency-order
what: See-through and masked textures drawn in the order and with the blending of the original

label: r26-pr211-async-loading
what: Textures and images can load on worker threads (`AsyncLoading`, off by default)

label: r27-pr220-evaluation-order
what: Call arguments evaluated in the order of the original compiler by default

label: r28-pr221-for-loops
what: `For` limits are evaluated on every pass, like the original

label: r29-pr219-sprite-hull
what: Sprites drawn as the part of the square that their texture is visible in

label: r30-root
what: Current root (sprite shapes of compressed textures)
